chapter: Hines 1935-38, Gus Arnheim and Billy Eckstine
title: Cliques in the Hines band
summary: Factions divide the band as Hines and Fox feud, and Budd lists the trumpets and trombones.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So, anyway, we went on -- we had a great time. And, so, finally, as I said, Earl Fox and -- I mean, Earl Hines and Ed Fox were beginning to feud. And, we had our cliques in the band, too, at that time. We had the different factions in the band.
Who was -- who was some of the guys in that band then, Budd?
Well, we had Walter Fuller, trumpet. We had Milton Fletcher, trumpet.
We had George Dixon, trumpet, and double in sax. And, we had Ed Simms, trumpet. Then, we had -- Taylor was still in the band.
Louis Taylor, trombone. Who was others band? I think we had Rabbit. What was Rabbit's real name, man? As well as I know him --
-- I can't re -- and, I think your boy Ed Fant.
